title: EmailSubmission/set process_create: BackendSetError::Other mapped to invalidProperties
description: submission.rs:565-570: when create_object returns BackendSetError::Other(inner), the handler returns SetError::new(SetErrorType::InvalidProperties).with_description(inner.to_string()). A storage failure is reported to the client as 'your properties are invalid', which is wrong and will mislead debugging. Similarly at submission.rs:572-574: serde serialization failure on the created object reports as InvalidProperties. Fix: use a SetErrorType that communicates server failure (or consider mapping to a serverFail JSON object directly).
